fluff.overview: Infantry within the Legiones Marianes form the backbone of planetary garrison and territorial defense, freeing the Hegemony's limited BattleMech assets for offensive operations and prestige assignments. A triplus contubernium, or triple tent-group, combines three squads of ten soldiers mounted on light vehicles. Motorized triplus contubernia provide fast-moving infantry support for Marian armored columns and conduct sweeps across open terrain where foot infantry cannot keep pace. Support elements carry man-portable short-range missile launchers firing the same warheads used by BattleMechs, giving the formation a potent anti-armor punch at close range.
